versions.provenance: Revised International Prognostic Scoring System (IPSS-R) for Myelodysplastic Syndromes; licensed clinical reference.
versions.introduction: Myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) do not use TNM staging. The Revised International Prognostic Scoring System (IPSS-R) is the universal clinical staging framework. It calculates an integer score based on 5 prognostic variables: cytogenetic risk category (Very Good, Good, Intermediate, Poor, Very Poor), bone marrow blast percentage, hemoglobin level, platelet count, and absolute neutrophil count (ANC).

t.label: Bone marrow blasts > 10% to 19% (>=20% defines AML)

n.label: Normal karyotype, del(5q), del(12p), del(20q), double abnormalities including del(5q)
del(7q), +8, +19, i(17q), any other single or double independent abnormalities
-7, inv(3)/t(3q)/del(3q), double abnormalities including -7/del(7q), complex (3 abnormalities)

stageGroups.basis: Median survival 8.8 years; 25% AML transformation at >14 years. Supportive care, ESAs, Luspatercept for ring sideroblasts.
Median survival 5.3 years; 25% AML evolution at 10.8 years. Lenalidomide standard for del(5q); ESAs for low EPO.
Median survival 3.0 years; 25% AML transformation at 3.2 years. High-risk treatment path if high-risk molecular mutations (TP53, ASXL1, RUNX1).
Median survival 1.6 years; 25% AML transformation at 1.4 years. Hypomethylating agents (Azacitidine) and allogeneic stem cell transplant evaluation.
Median survival 0.8 years; 25% AML evolution at 0.7 years. Immediate allogeneic stem cell transplantation evaluation or Azacitidine + clinical trials.

versions.regionalNodes: N/A for MDS. Evaluation focuses on bone marrow aspirate, core biopsy, and flow cytometry.
versions.histologicGrade: WHO 2022 / ICC classifications (MDS with low blasts, MDS with increased blasts MDS-IB1/IB2, MDS with bi-allelic TP53 inactivation, MDS with mutated SF3B1).
versions.histopathologicTypes: Myelodysplastic syndromes, MDS/MPN overlap syndromes (CMML, aCML).
prognosticFactors: Molecular genetics by NGS (IPSS-M): TP53 multi-hit, ASXL1, RUNX1, EZH2, SRSF2, U2AF1 confer adverse prognosis; SF3B1 favorable
